attributes.name: Druva - Short-Lived Administrator Account
attributes.description: Detects an administrator account that is created and subsequently deleted within 24 hours. Highlights potentially temporary or covert privileged access.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Detects an administrator account that is created and subsequently deleted within 24 hours. Highlights potentially temporary or covert privileged access.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.event_type == "Administrator Created"
    OR druva.event_type == "Administrator Deleted"

| EVAL target_admin =
    TO_STRING(user.email)

| EVAL actor =
    TO_STRING(user.id)

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL action = CASE(
    druva.event_type == "Administrator Created", "created",
    druva.event_type == "Administrator Deleted", "deleted",
    "other"
  )

| WHERE target_admin IS NOT NULL
    AND action != "other"

| STATS
    created_at =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE action == "created",

    deleted_at =
      MIN(event_time) WHERE action == "deleted",

    created_by =
      VALUES(actor) WHERE action == "created",

    deleted_by =
      VALUES(actor) WHERE action == "deleted",

    creation_results =
      VALUES(TO_STRING(event.outcome))
        WHERE action == "created",

    deletion_results =
      VALUES(TO_STRING(event.outcome))
        WHERE action == "deleted",

    creation_event_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)
        WHERE action == "created",

    deletion_event_types =
      VALUES(druva.event_type)
        WHERE action == "deleted",

    creation_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE action == "created",

    deletion_count =
      COUNT(*) WHERE action == "deleted"

  BY target_admin

| WHERE creation_count > 0
    AND deletion_count > 0
    AND deleted_at >= created_at

| EVAL lifetime_minutes =
    DATE_DIFF(
      "minutes",
      created_at,
      deleted_at
    )

| WHERE lifetime_minutes <= 1440
